speech.jaymoskingdoms.stench.0: Gods above, when did you last wash?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stench.1: Phew! Stand downwind of me, would you?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stench.2: There's a river not far off. Just saying.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stench.3: You smell like a tanner's yard.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stench.4: Keep away from the bread with that smell.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stench.5: The dogs will be after you, reeking like that.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stench.green.0: Hah! You smell almost like one of us.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stench.green.1: Good honest stink on you. I like it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stench.green.2: Finally, a soft-skin who doesn't smell of soap.
